english: A biased coin, for which the probability of a head in a single toss is $\dfrac{1}{3}$, is tossed $6$ times. Given that at least $4$ heads are obtained, the conditional probability that the first toss shows a head is
hindi: एक अभिनत सिक्का, जिसके एक उछाल में चित आने की प्रायिकता $\dfrac{1}{3}$ है, $6$ बार उछाला जाता है। दिया है कि कम से कम $4$ चित प्राप्त होते हैं, तो पहली उछाल में चित आने की सप्रतिबन्ध प्रायिकता है
solution: Given $X=k$, every arrangement of the $k$ heads is equally likely (each has probability $p^{k}q^{6-k}$), so $P(\text{first is H}\mid X=k)=\dfrac{k}{6}$
solution_full: Let $X$ be the number of heads; $X\sim B\left(6,\dfrac{1}{3}\right)$ with $p=\dfrac{1}{3}$, $q=\dfrac{2}{3}$.

Reduced sample space: given $X=k$, each of the $\binom{6}{k}$ head-tail sequences has the same probability $p^{k}q^{6-k}$, so they are equally likely. The first toss is a head in $\binom{5}{k-1}$ of them, and $\dfrac{\binom{5}{k-1}}{\binom{6}{k}}=\dfrac{k}{6}$.

Check by direct counting: first toss a head and at least $3$ heads among the remaining $5$ tosses: $p\left[\binom{5}{3}p^{3}q^{2}+\binom{5}{4}p^{4}q+p^{5}\right]=\dfrac{1}{3}\cdot\dfrac{40+10+1}{243}=\dfrac{51}{729}$.
$P(\text{first H}\mid X\ge4)=\dfrac{51/729}{73/729}=\dfrac{51}{73}$. The value $\dfrac{1}{3}$ would hold only without the condition.
originality_note: New: conditioning a biased binomial experiment on a tail event (at least 4 heads) and asking about one specified trial; inside each level X = k the bias cancels and the answer is the weighted average of k/6 (way 5: binomial distribution linked with the reduced sample space). Closest known: 'given at least one head in n tosses, probability of all heads' and P(X >= k) exercises. Different because: the question is about the identity of a trial, which needs the symmetry k/6 inside the reduced sample space.
blueprint_concepts: Conditional probability and the reduced sample space

concept_use.Binomial probability distribution: P(X = 4), P(X = 5), P(X = 6) are binomial probabilities with p = 1/3.
concept_use.Conditional probability and the reduced: Given X = k the sequences are equally likely (reduced sample space), so P(first is H | X = k) = k/6, and the conditional probability is formed from these.
